# Topped up

> The page a payment link returns to. It adds the top-up to the balance once per payment reference in its address, and adds nothing when opened without one. It does not check the payment, by design.

*Source: <https://customers.riskmandate.ai/account/topped-up.html> · site v0.2.1 (2026-10-21) · this file is generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift. Every page on this site has a `.md` twin; internal links below point at them.*

---

This page trusts the payment reference in its address, as [the meter's security model](https://newsroom.sgit.ai/meter/security.html#return) explains: opened without one, it adds nothing and says so. [Your account](/account/index.md).
